name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle on no more than three wheels with a wheel rim of at least 250 mm and a wheelbase of at least 1,016 mm, enclosed, open and limited-speed motorcycles and motor tricycles included; an electric motorcycle certified for the road is one.

restrictions.rule: An enclosed, open or limited-speed motorcycle or motor tricycle on no more than three wheels, with a wheel rim diameter of at least 250 mm and a wheelbase of at least 1,016 mm
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, s. 3; Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1)

restrictions.rule: No more than three wheels, an unladen seat height over 700 mm, a wheel rim diameter over 250 mm, a wheelbase over 1 m, and able to hold 70 km/h laden
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, s. 2(ac)

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed
One with a top speed of 70 km/h or less is a limited-speed motorcycle
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 or 6N licence, or a licence of another class with a motorcycle endorsement; the motorcycle learner endorsement requires age 16 and a licence of another class
restrictions.citation: Driver's Licence Regulations, N.S. Reg. 226/2026, ss. 3 and 10; Driver Licensing Requirements Regulations, N.S. Reg. 236/2026, s. 28

restrictions.rule: Riders need a driver's licence authorizing a motorcycle; on a learner's licence, no passenger and no riding from a half hour after sunset to a half hour before sunrise
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, ss. 70B and 76

restrictions.rule: The rider and any passenger must wear an approved motorcycle helmet certified to BSI, Snell, US DOT or ECE standards, fastened under the chin
restrictions.citation: Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, ss. 112, 115 and 116

restrictions.rule: The rider and any passenger must wear protective headgear of a prescribed kind on a highway
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, s. 170

restrictions.rule: No passenger under 9 years old, under 18 kg or shorter than 145 cm, and no riding side-saddle or on the handlebar, frame or tank
restrictions.citation: Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, s. 112

restrictions.rule: Registered and insured to be driven on a highway
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, S.N.S. 2025, c. 20, ss. 115 and 149

restrictions.rule: Registered and insured to be driven on a highway
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, ss. 13 and 230

restrictions.rule: Its rider is a vulnerable road user
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, s. 15

restrictions.rule: An electric dirt bike not built for the road is an off-highway vehicle instead
